config.heading: How to Use the Free Organization Chart Generator

items.title: Configure Your Organization Settings
points: Toggle logo visibility on/off as needed

items.title: Define Hierarchy Levels
points: Add organizational levels (e.g., CEO, VP, Director, Manager, Employee)
Assign custom colors to each level for visual distinction
Add or remove levels based on your organizational structure

items.title: Import Employee Data
points: Upload your CSV file with employee information
Required columns: Name, Position, Department, Manager Name
The tool automatically maps reporting relationships

items.title: Review and Edit
points: View your automatically generated organizational chart
Click on any employee card to edit details
Update names, positions, departments, or reporting lines as needed
Add new employees manually if required

items.title: Export Your Chart
points: Click "Copy to Clipboard" for instant use in presentations
Or click "Export as PDF" to download a professional document
Share or present your org chart immediately
